plain: A HarmBench test request that comes with a passage of text the model must use, such as a document to rewrite harmfully.
eli5: A trick question that only makes sense after you read the story that comes with it.
technical: One of HarmBench's three text behaviour types (alongside standard and copyright), whose ContextString column holds a passage prepended to the request; it is unrelated to the agentic-privacy report's "contextual behavior norm".
